Definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme DR-TB Treatment Register. One model instance represents a DR-TB
treatment register and contains repeatable patient entries covering
registration, treatment initiation, diagnosis and baseline investigations,
longitudinal bacteriological follow-up, TB/HIV activities and treatment
outcomes.
Identifier assigned to the DR-TB treatment register or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the DR-TB treatment unit or facility maintaining the register, when available.
Name of the DR-TB treatment unit or facility maintaining the register.
Constraint(s): Page 2 Header: Name of DR-TB Treatment Unit/Facility

Definition: State in which the DR-TB register is maintained.
Local Government Area in which the DR-TB register is maintained.
Reporting quarter shown on the continuation/follow-up page of the source register.
Reporting month shown on the continuation/follow-up page of the source register.
Reporting year shown on the continuation/follow-up page of the source register.
One longitudinal patient row in the DR-TB Treatment Register.

Definition: Reference to the corresponding Nigeria Core Patient resource, when available.
Sequential patient serial number assigned within the register.
Date the patient was entered into the DR-TB treatment register.
Place where DR-TB treatment was initiated. Source values are C for Community and TC for Treatment Centre.
Constraint(s): Place of Initiation: C = Community / TC = Treatment Centre

Definition: Programme registration number assigned to the patient for DR-TB care.
Patient name as recorded in the DR-TB treatment register.
Patient sex as recorded in the source register.
Patient age at registration.
Patient date of birth. The source register records age above and date of birth below in the same column.
Constraint(s): Age: Below - Insert Date of Birth

Definition: Full address of the patient.
Reference to the health facility that referred the patient, when available.
Full name of the referring health facility.
Constraint(s): Name of the Referring Health Facility in Full

Definition: State of the referring health facility.
Constraint(s): Referring Health Facility: Above - Enter Name of State

Definition: LGA of the referring health facility.
Constraint(s): Referring Health Facility: Below - Enter Name of LGA

Short: Previous intake of second-line TB drugs
Definition: Indicates whether the patient previously received second-line anti-TB drugs.
Constraint(s): Previous intake of second line TB drugs: Above Y/N

Short: Date of previous second-line TB drug intake
Definition: Relevant date recorded beneath the previous second-line drug-intake indicator.
Constraint(s): Previous intake of second line TB drugs: Below date

Definition: Patient weight recorded at registration.
Patient height recorded at registration.

DR-TB treatment regimen recorded in the source register.
Expected source categories are:
Shorter Regimen (Injectable),
Shorter Regimen (Bdq),
Individualized (Pre-XDR),
Individualized (XDR).
New DR-TB drug included in the regimen. Source examples are Bdq (Bedaquiline) and Dlm (Delamanid).
Constraint(s): Enter Bdq or Dlm if patient's regimen contains new drugs

Definition: Date the patient's DR-TB treatment regimen was started.
Site of TB disease. Source values are P for Pulmonary and EP for Extra-pulmonary.
Constraint(s): Site of Disease: P = Pulmonary / EP = Extra-pulmonary

Definition:
Initial DR-TB registration classification. The source requires one of:
New,
Relapse,
Treatment after failure,
Treatment after loss to follow-up,
Other previously treated TB patient,
Unknown previous TB treatment history,
Transferred in.
Baseline bacteriological investigations, second-line LPA/DST and X-ray information recorded before or around treatment initiation.

Definition: Treatment follow-up month. The source register provides Months 1 through 27.
Date of the follow-up smear/culture examination.
Follow-up AFB smear result. Expected source values are Positive, Negative or Not done.
Follow-up culture result. Expected source values are Positive, Negative or Contaminated.
Patient HIV status. Source values are Positive, Negative or Unknown.
Constraint(s): TB/HIV activities: HIV Status - Positive / Negative / Unknown

Definition: Indicates whether the patient is receiving antiretroviral therapy.
Date antiretroviral therapy was started.
Constraint(s): TB/HIV activities: ART - Below Start date

Definition: Indicates whether the patient is receiving cotrimoxazole preventive therapy.
Date cotrimoxazole preventive therapy was started.
Constraint(s): TB/HIV activities: CPT - Below Start date

Definition:
Final DR-TB treatment outcome. Source categories are:
Cured,
Died,
Lost to follow-up,
Treatment Completed,
Treatment Failure,
Not evaluated.
Date associated with the final treatment outcome.
Additional comments recorded for the patient's DR-TB treatment course.
